story.titleZh: 威廉姆斯留住塞恩斯和阿尔本：留队是否正确？
story.summaryZh: 在2026赛季表现不佳之际，威廉姆斯车队成功说服卡洛斯·塞恩斯和亚历克斯·阿尔本留队。塞恩斯签署了新的多年合同，而阿尔本的2027年确认据The 比赛了解并非新比赛合同，而是与原合同中的退出条款有关。

story.originalTitle: Fortunate? Our verdict on Williams retaining Sainz and Albon
story.summaryEn: Amid a troubled 2026 Formula 1 season, Williams has convinced Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon to stay with the team. Sainz has agreed to a new multi-year commitment, while according to The Race, Albon's confirmation for 2027 relates to exit clauses in his existing contract rather than a new racing deal.
detailZh: 对于表现令人失望的2026年F1赛季，威廉姆斯车队迎来了一个好消息——它已经说服卡洛斯·塞恩斯（塞恩斯）和亚历克斯·阿尔本（阿尔本）留在车队。
这两份合同相隔一天宣布，塞恩斯同意了一项新的多年承诺，而据The 比赛了解，阿尔本并没有签订新的比赛合同——他的2027年确认实际上与合同中已有的退出条款有关。
在威廉姆斯这个艰难赛季的背景下，这一点非常重要。那么他们留下来的决定正确吗？而且，外面真的有更好的选择吗？
以下是我们对这些进展的看法：
威廉姆斯在这里算是幸运的。其他中游车队的选择仍然存在太多问号，而车手在这些车队间流动的迹象又太少，无法为阿尔本和塞恩斯提供令人信服的离开途径。在这种背景下，他们继续相信2026年前景所承载的全部希望，而不是盯着2026年极其糟糕的现实，是说得通的。
因为威廉姆斯赛车来得晚、速度慢、超重，而且今年几乎没有什么真正变快的希望——这原本可能（在某些情况下，甚至应该）彻底摧毁车队留住这两位极具实力的车手的机会，毕竟车队的计划显然是围绕借助规则大改实现一次巨大飞跃而制定的。而不是像现在这样大幅倒退。
任何一个对F1还怀有几分情怀的人，都希望看到威廉姆斯复兴。看着这支车队垫底令人心痛，看着它再次大步向前则令人欣慰。而今年恰好在新时代本该真正开花结果的时候出现如此重大的一次失足，这意味着车队进入2027年时，需要向车迷、尤其是向它的车手证明的东西实在太多了。
我想最大的问题是：塞恩斯还能去哪儿？是的，理论上还有奥迪，但奥迪也并没有真正惊艳世界。也许，与其在没有任何更好成功保证的情况下贸然跳船，还不如留在熟悉的地方。
塞恩斯正处于职业生涯的一个阶段：如果他能留在这里，并尽最大努力帮助威廉姆斯重建为一支有竞争力的车队，人们对他的评价会高得多。他拥有那种驱动力和工程知识，能够把车队引向正确的方向——问题在于：车队会跟随他的领导吗？
威廉姆斯拥有塞恩斯和阿尔本两位好车手，所以如果下赛季依然缺乏竞争力，那就需要更深入地挖掘问题所在。
在所有因为2026年的失望而本可能最倾向于止损并跳槽的车手中，塞恩斯绝对是排在最前列的。
在威廉姆斯全力以赴提前投入新规则赛车设计之后，本赛季本应是它大放异彩的一个赛季。
因此，在拥有一辆迟到、超重且缺乏竞争力的赛车的情况下，这种挣扎的规模对于像 Sainz 这样水准的车手来说，尤其难以仅仅一笑置之、默默承受并希望车队挺过去。
他承诺留队，必须被视为两个因素结合的结果。
第一是 威廉姆斯 至少已经接受并承认了对事情不顺利的责任——并承诺做出必要的改变，以确保今年出现的错误不会再次发生。如果一味否认，并带着一堆借口盲目前行，那是不可接受的。
但还有一个因素是，外部选择对 Sainz 来说相当有限，他无法找到能在短期内保证更好的去处。
前四名车队看起来都已锁定——维斯塔潘确认留在红牛的消息应该很快就会公布——而即使是排名靠后的车队，秩序也不太可能被撼动。
小红牛（小红牛）是一个封闭的圈子。奥迪对霍肯伯格很满意。阿斯顿·马丁短期内仍是一场赌博，需要先弄清自己能取得多大进步。而阿尔派从来就不在考虑范围内。
就目前而言，威廉姆斯已经打消了塞恩斯认为别处草更绿（换个车队更好）的念头。但它知道，自己必须兑现进步的承诺。
尽管车队宣称塞恩斯的合同是多年合同，但现代合同中充满了各种选择条款——而且我们都知道，他的管理团队足够精明，不会不给自己留违约退路，以防顶级车队的空缺最终出现时可以脱身。
威廉姆斯为自己赢得了时间，James Vowles 和团队凭借有力的论证赢得了极高的赞誉，其中包括那些在2024年最初成功从奥迪和阿尔派的诱惑中争取到塞恩斯的论据。
但要说服阿尔本、尤其是塞恩斯在2027年之后继续留下，这场争夺战其实早已打响——届时可能比现在有更多诱人的选择可以转投他处。
塞恩斯已经承诺效力威廉姆斯，但这并不意味着在接下来的12个月里他不会密切关注竞争对手的动向。
我仍然认为，他是阿斯顿·马丁阿隆索的理想接班人，或者正是奥迪所需要的领军人物。
他在赛道外那种不懈的职业态度，至今仍深深留在老东家迈凯伦和法拉利的记忆中。
此外，他在赛道上还有着顽强的拼搏精神，这意味着奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里说的没错——塞恩斯即使为最后一名也会像争夺世界冠军一样战斗——只不过这种特质在99%的比赛中都是优点，也正是威廉姆斯能够保留这套远优于目前赛车的车手阵容、堪称一大胜利的原因。
我相信卡洛斯·塞恩斯的报酬一定非常丰厚，但这笔交易看起来对威廉姆斯的好处要远远大于对他本人。
这个赛季他有时可能稍微失宠于F1大众观众，但我仍然认为，他身上有实力可以为一家更有上升空间的车队提供价值。
威廉姆斯很可能在下赛季完成逆转、改变自己的命运——我们以前见过它做到过——但从今年的表现来看，它在成绩方面似乎并没有提供太多东西。
我很钦佩塞恩斯（Sainz）的信念，他相信自己能帮助车队重回更成功的道路，但我忍不住觉得，在未来几年某个重大多米诺骨牌不可避免地倒下时，他在车手市场上本会是一位引人注目的棋子。
detailEn: There's some good news for Williams to come out of its underwhelming 2026 Formula 1 season - as it's convinced Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon to stay with the team.

Those two deals, announced a day apart, involve Sainz agreeing to a new multi-year commitment, while with Albon The Race understands no new racing contract has been agreed - and that instead his 2027 confirmation relates to exit clauses that existed in the contract.
And that's pertinent in the context of this troubled Williams campaign. So were they right to stay? And was there ever a better option out there anyway?
Here's our reaction to those developments:

Williams has been fortunate here. There are still just a few too many question marks over the other midfield options, and too few signs of driver movement at them, to offer convincing exit routes for Albon and Sainz, and in that context it makes sense for them to still believe in all of the promise of the lead-up to 2026 over the absolutely terrible reality of their 2026.

Because the Williams arriving late, being slow and overweight, and not having much real hope of getting any quicker this year, could - and in some circumstances, should - have torpedoed the team's chances of keeping two drivers with so much to offer in F1, given its plan had been so clearly built around taking a big leap forward with the regulation change. Not a giant tumble backwards.

Anyone with a bit of F1 romance in them wants to see a Williams resurgence. It was painful to see this team at the bottom, and heartwarming to see it striding forwards again. This year is such a big misstep, just at the time its new era should have really started bearing fruit, that it goes into 2027 with a massive amount to prove to its fans and particularly its drivers.

I suppose the big question is where else could Sainz go? Yes, there is potentially Audi, but it is not really setting the world alight. Perhaps it's better the devil you know than jumping ship with no guarantees of any better success.

Sainz is at a time in his career where he will be thought a lot more of by staying put and doing the best he can to build Williams back into a competitive team. He has that drive and engineering knowledge to point it in the right direction - the question is: will it follow his lead?
Williams has two good drivers in Sainz and Albon, so if it is still uncompetitive next season then it needs to look deeper to find the problems.
Of all the drivers who would have been prime for cutting their losses and jumping ship off the back of 2026 disappointment, Sainz was right up there.
This season was supposed to be the big one for Williams after it threw everything at going early with its new-rules design.

So, the scale of its struggles, with a late, overweight and uncompetitive car, were particularly difficult for someone of Sainz's calibre to accept as something simply to smile at, endure and hope the team got through.
That he has committed to staying has to be seen as a marriage of two factors.

The first is that Williams has at least accepted and owned up to the responsibility of things not working - and committed to making necessary changes to ensure that what has gone wrong this year does not happen again. Being in denial, and ploughing on blindly with a bunch of excuses, would not have cut it.
But there is also an element that outside options were pretty limited for Sainz to get himself anywhere else that could be guaranteed to be better in the short term.
The top-four teams all look locked down - Max Verstappen's confirmation of remaining at Red Bull should be imminent - and even going down the order there is not much scope for a shake-up.
Racing Bulls is a closed shop. Audi is happy with Nico Hulkenberg. Aston Martin remains a gamble in the short term to work out how much progress it can make. And Alpine was never really on the radar.
For now, Williams has headed off Sainz's thoughts of the grass being greener anywhere else. But it knows that it needs to deliver on steps forward.

And while it has hailed Sainz's contract as multi-year, modern deals are full of options - and we know his management team is too smart to have given itself no break clauses that would prevent an escape route if some top-line vacancies do eventually open up.

Williams has bought itself time, and James Vowles and co deserve great credit for the strength of their arguments, including those that won Sainz from the temptation of Audi and Alpine in the first place in 2024.
But the race will already be on to convince Albon and particularly Sainz to stick around beyond 2027 - when there may be more tempting options to move elsewhere than there are presently.
Sainz has committed himself to Williams, but that doesn't mean he won't be spending some of the next 12 months keeping an eye on the competition.
I still see him as the ideal successor to Fernando Alonso at Aston Martin or the leader Audi needs.
He has a relentless off-track work ethic that still sticks in the minds of former employers McLaren and Ferrari.

Plus, he has the dogged on-track determination that means Oscar Piastri is right when he says Sainz fights for last place like the world championship - except that's a positive in 99% of races and exactly why it's such a win for Williams to retain a driver line-up that's far better than its current car.
I'm sure Carlos Sainz is being excellently reimbursed for his time but this is a deal that seems to be a lot more beneficial to Williams than to him.
He may have fallen slightly out of favour with the general F1 watching audience at times this season but I still think there's a driver in there who could offer a more upwardly mobile team something.
Williams may well complete a turnaround and change its fortunes next season - we've seen it do so before - but on this year's performances it doesn't appear to be offering much in terms of results.

I admire Sainz's conviction that he can help the team return to more successful ways but I can't help but feel he would have been an interesting player in the driver market when one of the BIG dominoes inevitably falls in the next few years.

relatedItems.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
relatedItems.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
relatedItems.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”

relatedItems.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥孔离开哈斯车队时再度提及“超出自己控制的因素”，暗示这段车手与车队关系的逐渐恶化。哈斯早在夏休期后便通知奥孔大概率不会留队，而法拉利支持的青训车手拉法·卡马拉被认为是接替他的热门人选。
relatedItems.originalTitle: All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart
relatedItems.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon marked his exit from Haas with another reference to elements beyond his control, hinting at a gradual deterioration of the driver-team relationship. Haas decided long ago not to activate its contractual option and informed Ocon shortly after the summer break that he was unlikely to be retained.
keyPointsZh: 哈斯拥有下赛季保留奥孔的合同选择权，但早已决定不激活，并在夏休期后不久通知了他。
法拉利支持的拉法·卡马拉是最热门的接替人选，有人推测是法拉利对其青训车手的支持将奥孔挤出车门。
签约时奥孔是哈斯自2016年车队成立赛季引进罗曼·格罗斯让以来拥有的最成功车手。
keyPointsEn: Haas had a contractual option to retain Ocon for next year, decided long ago not to activate it, and notified him shortly after the summer break.
Ferrari-backed Rafa Camara is the favourite to replace Ocon, leading some to infer Ferrari's support of its junior driver is pushing Ocon out.
When signed, Ocon was the most successful driver Haas had employed since Romain Grosjean, a 10-time podium finisher who joined for the team's inaugural 2016 season.

relatedItems.titleZh: 马来西亚大奖赛回归在即，车手期待雪邦或将上演混乱激战
relatedItems.summaryZh: 阔别近十年后，F1将于2026年重返雪邦，替代被取消的巴林和沙特大奖赛，车手们对这条久未造访的赛道展开了各自的预测。
relatedItems.originalTitle: 'Chaotic racing'? - What F1 drivers expect from Malaysia return
relatedItems.summaryEn: Formula 1 will return to Sepang in 2026 after nearly a decade away, replacing the cancelled Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands Prix, and drivers have been sharing their early predictions about the challenge ahead.
keyPointsZh: 大部分车手在阿塞拜疆-马来西亚-新加坡三连赛开始前已在模拟器上为雪邦做了准备
威廉姆斯的模拟数据显示，雪邦在2026年赛道中的能源管理需求约为中等水平，与加拿大和奥地利站相近
世界冠军兰多·诺里斯曾在2017年为迈凯伦车手阿隆索和范多恩担任模拟器支持工作
keyPointsEn: Most drivers had already completed simulator preparations for Sepang before the Azerbaijan-Malaysia-Singapore triple header began
Williams's data places Sepang around average in energy management demands for 2026 circuits, similar to Canada and Austria
World champion Lando Norris provided sim support for McLaren's race drivers Fernando Alonso and Stoffel Vandoorne the last time F1 raced there in 2017
